brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases at (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (3,0) on level 0, in a straight row. Mesh check is clear.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: One continuous run (run-1, potable mode default) starts at (0,0) entering edge 3 and passes straight through (1,0), (2,0) and (3,0). The run is a straight line because the router only allowed straight-through passes per cell, so a four-cell cluster in a bent shape could not be covered by one pipe.

requirements.requirement: Planter suitable to hold soil (implied by 'planter')
requirements.evidence: Bins were tried in every cell (drained, PVC-bore variants and plain drained) but each one MESH_CLASHes with the pvc-pipe (1.35 mm overlap vs 0.5 mm limit), so no bin is fitted. The build is the bases and pipe only; a soil container would need a different pipe route or bin design.

finish.summary: The build is four hex bases in a row with one continuous water pipe (run-1) through all four cells; check_build reports meshClash clear with no rule errors (only info-level open cap faces). The planter's soil bins could not be added because they clash with the pipe, so the planter is structurally complete but has no soil containers.

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
